title: Adi-khanda, part 3 (portion 11)
html:
Balya-lila (continued): Nimai pretends not to hear His mother; He sits again on the discarded pots, throws a brick at His mother and brings two coconuts; Shachi for a moment realizes that her son is Narayana, but forgets it again in love for her son and recites protective names over Him; Nimai cries for the moon from the sky; His play with a puppy

Raga shri; disha: "O-ki ho re, Gauranga, jaya, jaya!" (murchha). "O-ki na, my prema for Gauranga — nectar and bliss! Ki na, my Gauranga, ki are, jaya, jaya!"

এইমতে দিনে দিনে ক্ষণে ক্ষণে আন ।
বাঢ়য়ে শরীর যেন সুমেরু-সুঠাম ॥ ২০৮ ॥

eimate dine dine kṣaṇe kṣaṇe āna |
bāṛhaẏe śarīra yena sumeru-suṭhāma || 208 ||

ei-mate dine dine — thus day by day; kshane kshane ana — different every moment; badhaye sharira — the body grows; yena sumeru-suthama — shapely as Sumeru

208So day by day, changing every moment,
His body grows, shapely as Mount Sumeru.

অমৃতের ধারা যেন বচন-মাধুরী ।
শুনি শচীদেবী মনে অতি কুতূহলী ॥ ২০৯ ॥

amṛtera dhārā yena bacana-mādhurī |
śuni śacīdebī mane ati kutūhalī || 209 ||

amritera dhara yena — like a stream of nectar; vachana-madhuri — the sweetness of speech; shuni shachidevi — hearing, Shachi-devi; mane ati kutuhali — is very delighted at heart

209The sweetness of His speech is like a stream of nectar;
hearing it, Shachi-devi rejoices at heart.

কথাচ্ছলে কথা শুনিবারে চাহে রাণী ।
প্রভু কহে শুনিতে না পাই তোর বাণী ॥ ২১০ ॥

kathācchale kathā śunibāre cāhe rāṇī |
prabhu kahe śunite nā pāi tora bāṇī || 210 ||

kathachchhale — on the pretext of talk; katha shunibare chahe rani — the queen wants to hear [Him] speak; prabhu kahe — the Lord says; shunite na pai — I cannot hear; tora vani — your words

210On the pretext of conversation the queen wants to hear Him speak;
the Lord says: "I can't hear what you say."

উচ্চ করি শচী ডাকে মহাকুতূহলী ।
শুনিতে না পাই কহে গোরা বনমালী ॥ ২১১ ॥

ucca kari śacī ḍāke mahākutūhalī |
śunite nā pāi kahe gorā banamālī || 211 ||

uchcha kari shachi dake — Shachi calls loudly; maha-kutuhali — in great merriment; shunite na pai — I cannot hear; kahe gora vanamali — says Gora, wearer of the forest garland

211Shachi calls Him loudly, in great merriment;
"I can't hear!" says Gora, who wears the forest garland.

বাৎসল্য-প্রেমেতে মুগ্ধ হৈলা শচীমাতা ।
ক্রোধ করি ছড়ি লঞা ধায় উনমতা ॥ ২১২ ॥

bātsalya-premete mugdha hailā śacīmātā |
krodha kari chaṛi lañā dhāẏa unamatā || 212 ||

vatsalya-premete — by parental love; mugdha haila shachimata — mother Shachi was enchanted; krodha kari — in anger; chhadi lana — taking a switch; dhaya unamata — runs like a madwoman

212Mother Shachi, enchanted by parental love (vatsalya),
angrily seizes a switch and runs like a madwoman:

আজি বাক্য নাহি শুন উদ্ধতের মত ।
বৃদ্ধকালে তুমি মোরে নাহি দিবে ভাত ॥ ২১৩ ॥

āji bākya nāhi śuna uddhatera mata |
bṛddhakāle tumi more nāhi dibe bhāta || 213 ||

aji vakya nahi shuna — today You don't listen to words; uddhatera mata — like a naughty one; vriddha-kale — in old age; tumi more nahi dibe bhata — You will not give me rice

213"Today You won't listen to [my] words, like a naughty boy —
in my old age You won't even give me rice to eat!"

আর কথোদিনে সেই শচীর নন্দন ।
খটি করি না শুনয়ে মায়ের বচন ॥ ২১৪ ॥

āra kathodine sei śacīra nandana |
khaṭi kari nā śunaẏe māẏera bacana || 214 ||

ara kathodine — some days later; sei shachira nandana — that son of Shachi; khati kari — being stubborn; na shunaye mayera vachana — does not listen to His mother's words

214And some days later the son of Shachi,
being stubborn, does not listen to His mother's words.

রুষিলা সে শচীদেবী চাহে একদিঠে ।
ধাঞা ধরিবারে যায় হাথে করি ছাটে ॥ ২১৫ ॥

ruṣilā se śacīdebī cāhe ekadiṭhe |
dhāñā dharibāre yāẏa hāthe kari chāṭe || 215 ||

rushila se shachidevi — Shachi-devi grew angry; chahe ekadithe — stares fixedly; dhana dharibare yaya — runs to catch [Him]; hathe kari chhate — with a switch in hand

215Shachi-devi grew angry, stared at Him fixedly,
and ran to catch Him with a switch in her hand.

ধাঞা বিশ্বম্ভর গেলা অশুচির স্থানে ।
ত্যক্ত মৃত্তিকার ভাণ্ড বর্জয়ে যেখানে ॥ ২১৬ ॥

dhāñā biśbambhara gelā aśucira sthāne |
tyakta mṛttikāra bhāṇḍa barjaẏe yekhāne || 216 ||

dhana vishvambhara gela — Vishvambhara ran off; ashuchira sthane — to the impure place; tyakta mrittikara bhanda — useless earthen pots; varjaye yekhane — where they are thrown away

216Vishvambhara ran off to the impure place
where useless earthen pots are thrown away.

দেখিয়া জননী নিজ-শিরে কর হানি ।
হাহাকার করে শচী বোলে কটুবাণী ॥ ২১৭ ॥

dekhiẏā jananī nija-śire kara hāni |
hāhākāra kare śacī bole kaṭubāṇī || 217 ||

dekhiya janani — seeing, the mother; nija-shire kara hani — strikes her own head with her hand; hahakara kare shachi — Shachi laments; bole katuvani — speaks harsh words

217Seeing it, His mother strikes her head with her hand;
Shachi laments and scolds Him with harsh words.

অধিক সে বিশ্বম্ভর রুষিল হিয়ায় ।
উপরি উপরি ভাণ্ডে উঠিয়া দাণ্ডায় ॥ ২১৮ ॥

adhika se biśbambhara ruṣila hiẏāẏa |
upari upari bhāṇḍe uṭhiẏā dāṇḍāẏa || 218 ||

adhika — even more; se vishvambhara rushila hiyay — Vishvambhara grew angry at heart; upari upari bhande — on the pots piled one upon another; uthiya dandaya — climbs and stands

218Vishvambhara grew angrier still at heart:
He climbed onto the pots heaped one upon another and stood on them.

কুপিত বচন শুনি করে বিপরীত ।
বুঝিয়া জননী কিছু করয়ে পিরীত ॥ ২১৯ ॥

kupita bacana śuni kare biparīta |
bujhiẏā jananī kichu karaẏe pirīta || 219 ||

kupita vachana shuni — hearing angry words; kare viparita — does the opposite; bujhiya janani — understanding, the mother; kichhu karaye pirita — shows some affection

219Hearing angry words, He does the opposite;
understanding this, His mother spoke gently:

আইস আইস বাপ ছাড় জুগুপ্সিত কর্ম ।
এ নহে উচিত তোর ব্রাহ্মণের ধর্ম ॥ ২২০ ॥

āisa āisa bāpa chāṛa jugupsita karma |
e nahe ucita tora brāhmaṇera dharma || 220 ||

aisa aisa bapa — come, come, child; chhada jugupsita karma — leave this disgusting act; e nahe uchita tora — this is not fitting for You; brahmanera dharma — [it is not] a brahmana's dharma

220"Come, come here, child, leave this disgusting business!
It is not fitting for You — it is not the dharma of a brahmana.

ব্রাহ্মণ-কুমার তাহে কুলীনের পুত্র ।
শুনি কি বলিব লোকে কুৎসিত চরিত্র ॥ ২২১ ॥

brāhmaṇa-kumāra tāhe kulīnera putra |
śuni ki baliba loke kutsita caritra || 221 ||

brahmana-kumara — a brahmana's son; tahe kulinera putra — and a kulina's son besides; shuni ki baliba loke — what will people say on hearing; kutsita charitra — of shameful conduct

221You are a brahmana's son, and of a noble (kulina) family besides;
what will people say when they hear of such shameful conduct?

আইস আইস বাপু স্নান কর গঙ্গাজলে ।
মায়ের পরাণ ফাটে চড় আসিয়া কোলে ॥ ২২২ ॥

āisa āisa bāpu snāna kara gaṅgājale |
māẏera parāṇa phāṭe caṛa āsiẏā kole || 222 ||

aisa aisa bapu — come, come, child; snana kara gangajale — bathe in the Ganga's water; mayera parana phate — the mother's heart is breaking; chada asiya kole — come up into my arms

222Come, come, child, bathe in the water of the Ganga;
Your mother's heart is breaking — come, climb into my arms.

নহে বা মরিব এই গঙ্গায় ঝাঁপ দিয়া ।
এ ঘরে ও ঘরে যেন বেড়াসি কান্দিয়া ॥ ২২৩ ॥

nahe bā mariba ei gaṅgāẏa jhāṁpa diẏā |
e ghare o ghare yena beṛāsi kāndiẏā || 223 ||

nahe ba mariba — or else I will die; ei gangaya jhanpa diya — jumping into this Ganga; e ghare o ghare — from this house to that; yena bedasi kandiya — so that You wander weeping

223Otherwise I will throw myself into the Ganga and die —
and You will go weeping from house to house.

কষিত এ দশবাণ সুবরণ তনু ।
এহেন সুন্দর গায় কালি মাখ কেনু ॥ ২২৪ ॥

kaṣita e daśabāṇa subaraṇa tanu |
ehena sundara gāẏa kāli mākha kenu || 224 ||

kashita — tested on the touchstone; e dashabana suvarana tanu — this body of finest gold; ehena sundara gaya — on such a beautiful body; kali makha kenu — why do You smear soot

224Your body is gold of the finest purity, tested on the touchstone:
why do You smear soot on such a beautiful body?

অশুচি কুৎসিত স্থান ছাড় বাপু মোর ।
চান্দের কলঙ্ক যেন গায়ে কালি তোর ॥ ২২৫ ॥

aśuci kutsita sthāna chāṛa bāpu mora |
cāndera kalaṅka yena gāẏe kāli tora || 225 ||

ashuchi kutsita sthana — the impure, foul place; chhada bapu mora — leave, my child; chandera kalanka yena — like the stain on the moon; gaye kali tora — the soot on Your body

225Leave this impure, foul place, my child:
the soot on Your body is like the stain on the moon."

শুনিঞা রুষিল বিশ্বম্ভর গুণরাশি ।
বারে বারে কহোঁ তোরে তভু না বুঝসি ॥ ২২৬ ॥

śuniñā ruṣila biśbambhara guṇarāśi |
bāre bāre kahoṁ tore tabhu nā bujhasi || 226 ||

shunina — hearing; rushila vishvambhara gunarashi — Vishvambhara, treasury of virtues, grew angry; bare bare kahon tore — again and again I tell you; tabhu na bujhasi — yet you do not understand

226Hearing this, Vishvambhara, the treasury of virtues, grew angry:
"Again and again I tell you — and still you do not understand!

অশুচি অশুচি বলি বোলসি কুবোল ।
কি শুচি অশুচি আগে বিচারহ মোর ॥ ২২৭ ॥

aśuci aśuci bali bolasi kubola |
ki śuci aśuci āge bicāraha mora || 227 ||

ashuchi ashuchi bali — saying "impure, impure"; bolasi kubola — you speak ill words; ki shuchi ashuchi — what is pure, what impure; age vicharaha mora — judge first concerning Me

227Saying 'impure, impure', you speak ill words;
what is pure and what impure — judge that first concerning Me!"

ইহা বলি সম্মুখে ইষ্টকা লইল হাথে ।
ইষ্টকা প্রহার কৈল জননীর মাথে ॥ ২২৮ ॥

ihā bali sammukhe iṣṭakā laila hāthe |
iṣṭakā prahāra kaila jananīra māthe || 228 ||

iha bali — saying this; sammukhe ishtaka — a brick in front; laila hathe — took in hand; ishtaka prahara kaila — struck with the brick; jananira mathe — on His mother's head

228Saying this, He took in His hand a brick lying before Him
and struck His mother on the head with the brick.

প্রহারে কপট মূর্চ্ছা পাইল শচীরাণী ।
মা মা বলিয়া পুনঃ কান্দয়ে আপনি ॥ ২২৯ ॥

prahāre kapaṭa mūrcchā pāila śacīrāṇī |
mā mā baliẏā punaḥ kāndaẏe āpani || 229 ||

prahare — at the blow; kapata murchchha paila shachirani — Shachi-rani fell into a seeming swoon; ma ma baliya — crying "mother, mother"; punah kandaye apani — He Himself weeps

229At the blow Shachi-rani fell into a seeming swoon;1
"Mother, mother!" He Himself weeps.

কান্দনার রোল শুনি পুরনারীগণ ।
নিকটে যে ছিল ধাঞা আইল তখন ॥ ২৩০ ॥

kāndanāra rola śuni puranārīgaṇa |
nikaṭe ye chila dhāñā āila takhana || 230 ||

kandanara rola shuni — hearing the loud weeping; pura-narigana — the women of the town; nikate ye chhila — who were nearby; dhana aila takhana — came running at once

230Hearing the loud weeping, the women of the town
who were nearby came running at once.

গঙ্গাজল মুখে দিয়া সচেতন কৈল ।
সংজ্ঞামাত্র বিশ্বম্ভর বলিয়া ডাকিল ॥ ২৩১ ॥

gaṅgājala mukhe diẏā sacetana kaila |
saṃjñāmātra biśbambhara baliẏā ḍākila || 231 ||

gangajala mukhe diya — putting Ganga water on her face; sachetana kaila — brought her round; samjna-matra — as soon as conscious; vishvambhara baliya dakila — called "Vishvambhara!"

231Sprinkling Ganga water on her face, they brought her round;
as soon as she came to, she called: "Vishvambhara!"

বাহু পসারিয়া শচী পুত্র কোলে কৈল ।
মূর্চ্ছিত হঞা পূর্বজ্ঞান পাসরিল ॥ ২৩২ ॥

bāhu pasāriẏā śacī putra kole kaila |
mūrcchita hañā pūrbajñāna pāsarila || 232 ||

bahu pasariya — opening her arms; shachi putra kole kaila — Shachi took her son on her lap; murchchhita hana — having swooned; purva-jnana pasarila — forgot what had happened before

232Opening her arms, Shachi took her son on her lap;
coming out of her swoon, she forgot what had happened before.

কান্দয়ে সে বিশ্বম্ভর জননী দেখিয়া ।
তহি এক দিব্য নারী কহিল হাসিয়া ॥ ২৩৩ ॥

kāndaẏe se biśbambhara jananī dekhiẏā |
tahi eka dibya nārī kahila hāsiẏā || 233 ||

kandaye se vishvambhara — Vishvambhara weeps; janani dekhiya — looking at His mother; tahi eka divya nari — then a lovely woman; kahila hasiya — said laughing

233Vishvambhara weeps, looking at His mother;
then a lovely woman said with a laugh,

চিবুকে ধরিয়া বিশ্বম্ভরে বোলে বাণী ।
নারিকেল-ফল দুই মায়ে দেহ আনি ॥ ২৩৪ ॥

cibuke dhariẏā biśbambhare bole bāṇī |
nārikela-phala dui māẏe deha āni || 234 ||

chibuke dhariya — taking by the chin; vishvambhare bole vani — says to Vishvambhara; narikela-phala dui — two coconuts; maye deha ani — bring and give to your mother

234taking Vishvambhara by the chin:
"Go and bring your mother two coconuts —

তবে সে জীয়য়ে শচী এই তোর মাতা ।
নহে বা মরিব এই শুন মোর কথা ॥ ২৩৫ ॥

tabe se jīẏaẏe śacī ei tora mātā |
nahe bā mariba ei śuna mora kathā || 235 ||

tabe se jiyaye shachi — then Shachi will live; ei tora mata — this mother of yours; nahe ba mariba ei — otherwise she will die; shuna mora katha — listen to my word

235then your mother Shachi will live;
otherwise she will die — listen to me."

ইহা শুনি বিশ্বম্ভর হরিষ হইলা ।
তখনি যুগল নারিকেল আনি দিলা ॥ ২৩৬ ॥

ihā śuni biśbambhara hariṣa hailā |
takhani yugala nārikela āni dilā || 236 ||

iha shuni — hearing this; vishvambhara harisha haila — Vishvambhara was glad; takhani — at once; yugala narikela ani dila — brought a pair of coconuts

236Hearing this, Vishvambhara was glad
and at once brought a pair of coconuts —

তৎকাল-গলিত-বৃন্ত স্নিগ্ধ শোলবান ।
নারিকেল-যুগল দিল জননীর স্থান ॥ ২৩৭ ॥

tatkāla-galita-bṛnta snigdha śolabāna |
nārikela-yugala dila jananīra sthāna || 237 ||

tatkala-galita-vrinta — with stalks just broken off; snigdha — fresh; sholavana — juicy; narikela-yugala — the pair of coconuts; dila jananira sthana — gave to His mother

237their stalks just broken off, fresh and full of juice;
He placed the two coconuts before His mother.

দেখিয়া সে নারীগণ বিস্মিত হইলা ।
এইক্ষণে শিশু নারিকেল কোথা পাইলা ॥ ২৩৮ ॥

dekhiẏā se nārīgaṇa bismita hailā |
eikṣaṇe śiśu nārikela kothā pāilā || 238 ||

dekhiya se narigana — seeing, the women; vismita haila — were amazed; eikshane shishu — the child in a moment; narikela kotha paila — where did He get coconuts

238Seeing this, the women were amazed:
"Where did a child get coconuts in a moment?"

তহি এক দিব্য বিলাসিনী নারী আছে ।
লহু লহু বোলে বিশ্বম্ভরে কিছু পুছে ॥ ২৩৯ ॥

tahi eka dibya bilāsinī nārī āche |
lahu lahu bole biśbambhare kichu puche || 239 ||

tahi eka divya vilasini nari achhe — there was a lovely playful woman there; lahu lahu bole — speaking softly; vishvambhare kichhu puchhe — asks Vishvambhara something

239There was a lovely, playful woman there;
very softly she asks Vishvambhara:

শিশু হঞা নারিকেল কোথা পাইলে তুমি ।
তোমার চরিত্র কিছু বুঝিয়াছি আমি ॥ ২৪০ ॥

śiśu hañā nārikela kothā pāile tumi |
tomāra caritra kichu bujhiẏāchi āmi || 240 ||

shishu hana — being a child; narikela kotha paile tumi — where did You get the coconuts; tomara charitra kichhu — something of Your doings; bujhiyachhi ami — I have understood

240"You are a child — where did You get the coconuts?
I have understood something about Your doings!"

ঐছন শুনিঞা বাণী বিশ্বম্ভর রায় ।
হুহুঙ্কার করি ধরে মায়ের গলায় ॥ ২৪১ ॥

aichana śuniñā bāṇī biśbambhara rāẏa |
huhuṅkāra kari dhare māẏera galāẏa || 241 ||

aichhana shunina vani — hearing such words; vishvambhara raya — Vishvambhara Raya; huhunkara kari — roaring "hum"; dhare mayera galaya — clasps His mother's neck

241Hearing such words, Vishvambhara Raya
gave a fierce "hum!" and clasped His mother's neck.

সচেতন হঞা শচী পুত্র কৈল কোলে ।
লাখ লাখ চুম্ব দিল বদন-কমলে ॥ ২৪২ ॥

sacetana hañā śacī putra kaila kole |
lākha lākha cumba dila badana-kamale || 242 ||

sachetana hana — coming to herself; shachi putra kaila kole — Shachi took her son on her lap; lakha lakha chumba dila — gave hundreds of thousands of kisses; badana-kamale — to the lotus face

242Coming to herself, Shachi took her son on her lap
and covered His lotus face with countless kisses.

বয়ান মুছিল অঙ্গ বসন-অঞ্চলে ।
শ্রীঅঙ্গ-মার্জন কৈল সুরনদী-জলে ॥ ২৪৩ ॥

baẏāna muchila aṅga basana-añcale |
śrīaṅga-mārjana kaila suranadī-jale || 243 ||

bayana muchhila anga — wiped face and body; basana-anchale — with the end of her cloth; shri-anga-marjana kaila — washed the holy body; suranadi-jale — with the water of the heavenly river

243With the end of her cloth she wiped His face and body
and washed His holy body with the water of the heavenly river.

স্নান করাইল গঙ্গাজল-অভিষেকে ।
অন্তর-বিস্ময়ে পুত্র-বদন নিরীখে ॥ ২৪৪ ॥

snāna karāila gaṅgājala-abhiṣeke |
antara-bismaẏe putra-badana nirīkhe || 244 ||

snana karaila — bathed [Him]; gangajala-abhisheke — with an abhisheka of Ganga water; antara-vismaye — with wonder at heart; putra-badana nirikhe — gazes at her son's face

244Having bathed Him as if with an abhisheka of Ganga water,
she gazes in wonder at her son's face:

সমুদ্র-গম্ভীর কোটি-দিনকর-ছটা ।
কোটি-নিশাকর-তেজ নখ কুড়ি-গোটা ॥ ২৪৫ ॥

samudra-gambhīra koṭi-dinakara-chaṭā |
koṭi-niśākara-teja nakha kuṛi-goṭā || 245 ||

samudra-gambhira — deep as the ocean; koti-dinakara-chhata — the splendour of millions of suns; koti-nishakara-teja — the brilliance of millions of moons; nakha kudi-gota — the twenty nails

245deep as the ocean, with the splendour of millions of suns;
His twenty nails shine like millions of moons;

কোটি কাম জিনি রূপ সুবলিত তনু ।
রঙ্গিম ভঙ্গিম আঁখি ভুরু কামধনু ॥ ২৪৬ ॥

koṭi kāma jini rūpa subalita tanu |
raṅgima bhaṅgima āṁkhi bhuru kāmadhanu || 246 ||

koti kama jini rupa — beauty surpassing millions of Kamas; suvalita tanu — a graceful body; rangima bhangima ankhi — playful, curving eyes; bhuru kamadhanu — brows like Kama's bow

246beauty surpassing millions of Kamas, a graceful body,
playful, curving eyes, brows like Kama's bow.

সর্বলোকনাথ এ অবনী পরকাশ ।
দেখিয়া জননী পাইল অন্তরে তরাস ॥ ২৪৭ ॥

sarbalokanātha e abanī parakāśa |
dekhiẏā jananī pāila antare tarāsa || 247 ||

sarvaloka-natha — the Lord of all worlds; e avani parakasha — manifest on this earth; dekhiya janani — seeing, the mother; paila antare tarasa — felt awe within

247The Lord of all the worlds has appeared on earth —
seeing it, the mother felt awe in her heart.

পুরুব-রহস্য গর্ভধারণের কালে ।
দেখিল দেবতা দিব্য-যানে সেই বেলে ॥ ২৪৮ ॥

puruba-rahasya garbhadhāraṇera kāle |
dekhila debatā dibya-yāne sei bele || 248 ||

puruva-rahasya — the secret of the past; garbha-dharanera kale — when she bore [Him] in her womb; dekhila devata — she saw the gods; divya-yane — in celestial vehicles; sei bele — at that time

248The secret of the past came back: when she was carrying Him in her womb,
she had seen the gods in celestial vehicles.

আর যত বালক-চরিতে যে যে কৈল ।
এখন সকল সেই স্মরণ হইল ॥ ২৪৯ ॥

āra yata bālaka-carite ye ye kaila |
ekhana sakala sei smaraṇa haila || 249 ||

ara yata — and all that; balaka-charite — in His childhood doings; ye ye kaila — whatever He did; ekhana sakala sei — now all of it; smarana haila — came to mind

249And all that He had done before in His childhood play —
all of it now came back to her mind.

নিশ্চয় জানিল জ্যোতির্ময় সনাতন ।
নির্লেপ নিরঞ্জন নিরাকার নারায়ণ ॥ ২৫০ ॥

niścaẏa jānila jyotirmaẏa sanātana |
nirlepa nirañjana nirākāra nārāẏaṇa || 250 ||

nishchaya janila — she knew for certain; jyotirmaya sanatana — radiant, eternal; nirlepa — untainted; niranjana — pure; nirakara — without [mundane] form; narayana — Narayana

250She knew for certain: this is the radiant, eternal,
untainted, pure Narayana, without [mundane] form,2

সর্বময় সর্বশক্তিধর আত্মারাম ।
যোগীন্দ্রগণের ইঁহ ধ্যান অনুপাম ॥ ২৫১ ॥

sarbamaẏa sarbaśaktidhara ātmārāma |
yogīndragaṇera iṁha dhyāna anupāma || 251 ||

sarvamaya — all-pervading; sarva-shakti-dhara — bearer of all energies; atmarama — satisfied in Himself; yogindra-ganera — of the great yogis; inha dhyana anupama — He is the incomparable object of meditation

251all-pervading, bearer of all energies, satisfied in Himself,
the incomparable object of meditation of the great yogis.

মোর ভাগ্য গণিবারে নারে কোন জন ।
ব্রহ্মা-মহেশ্বর-আদি যত দেবগণ ॥ ২৫২ ॥

mora bhāgya gaṇibāre nāre kona jana |
brahmā-maheśbara-ādi yata debagaṇa || 252 ||

mora bhagya ganibare — to count my good fortune; nare kona jana — no one can; brahma-maheshvara-adi — Brahma, Maheshvara and others; yata devagana — all the gods

252"No one can measure my good fortune —
not Brahma, nor Maheshvara, nor the other gods:

সভার আরাধ্য এই আমার তনয় ।
বলিতে বলিতে কোলে কৈল গৌররায় ॥ ২৫৩ ॥

sabhāra ārādhya ei āmāra tanaẏa |
balite balite kole kaila gaurarāẏa || 253 ||

sabhara aradhya — worshipped by all; ei amara tanaya — this son of mine; balite balite — while saying so; kole kaila gauraraya — took Gauraraya in her arms

253this son of mine is the One whom all worship!"
Saying this, she took Gauraraya into her arms.

যেই-মাত্র শচী কোলে কৈল গৌরহরি ।
পুত্রভাবে শচীদেবী ঐশ্বর্য পাসরি ॥ ২৫৪ ॥

yei-mātra śacī kole kaila gaurahari |
putrabhābe śacīdebī aiśbarya pāsari || 254 ||

yei-matra — as soon as; shachi kole kaila gaurahari — Shachi took Gaurahari in her arms; putra-bhave — in the mood of a son; shachidevi aishvarya pasari — Shachi-devi forgot His majesty

254But as soon as Shachi took Gaurahari into her arms,
in her love for her son Shachi-devi forgot His majesty.3

ঘরেরে আইলা শচী বিস্ময় হইয়া ।
কোন দেব আবির্ভাব হৈল পুত্র দিয়া ॥ ২৫৫ ॥

gharere āilā śacī bismaẏa haiẏā |
kona deba ābirbhāba haila putra diẏā || 255 ||

gharere aila shachi — Shachi came home; vismaya haiya — in wonder; kona deva — what god; avirbhava haila — has manifested; putra diya — through my son

255Shachi came home in wonder:
"What god has manifested through my son?"

এত চিন্তি রক্ষা বান্ধে অঙ্গে হাথ দিয়া ।
জনার্দন হৃষীকেশ গোবিন্দ বলিয়া ॥ ২৫৬ ॥

eta cinti rakṣā bāndhe aṅge hātha diẏā |
janārdana hṛṣīkeśa gobinda baliẏā || 256 ||

eta chinti — thinking thus; raksha bandhe — ties a protective thread; ange hatha diya — touching His body; janardana hrishikesha govinda baliya — saying "Janardana, Hrishikesha, Govinda"

256Thinking this, she ties a protective thread and, touching His body,
says: "Janardana, Hrishikesha, Govinda!

শির তোর রক্ষা করু চক্র সুদর্শন ।
চক্ষু নাসিকা মুখ রাখুক নারায়ণ ॥ ২৫৭ ॥

śira tora rakṣā karu cakra sudarśana |
cakṣu nāsikā mukha rākhuka nārāẏaṇa || 257 ||

shira tora raksha karu — may [He] guard Your head; chakra sudarshana — the Sudarshana disc; chakshu nasika mukha — eyes, nose, mouth; rakhuka narayana — may Narayana protect

257May the Sudarshana disc guard Your head,
may Narayana protect Your eyes, nose and mouth;

বক্ষ তোর রক্ষা করু দেব গদাধর ।
ভুজ তোর রক্ষা করু দেব গিরিধর ॥ ২৫৮ ॥

bakṣa tora rakṣā karu deba gadādhara |
bhuja tora rakṣā karu deba giridhara || 258 ||

vaksha tora raksha karu — may [He] guard Your chest; deva gadadhara — Lord Gadadhara; bhuja tora raksha karu — may [He] guard Your arms; deva giridhara — Lord Giridhara

258may Lord Gadadhara guard Your chest,
may Lord Giridhara guard Your arms;

উদর-বক্ষণ তোর করু দামোদর ।
নাভিদেশ রক্ষা করু নৃসিংহ ঈশ্বর ॥ ২৫৯ ॥

udara-bakṣaṇa tora karu dāmodara |
nābhideśa rakṣā karu nṛsiṃha īśbara || 259 ||

udara-vankshana tora — Your belly and groin; karu damodara — may Damodara [guard]; nabhidesha raksha karu — may [He] guard the navel; nrisimha ishvara — Lord Nrisimha

259may Damodara guard Your belly and groin,
may Lord Nrisimha guard Your navel;

জানু দুই রক্ষা করু দেব ত্রিবিক্রম ।
রক্ষা করু ধরাধর তোর দুচরণ ॥ ২৬০ ॥

jānu dui rakṣā karu deba tribikrama |
rakṣā karu dharādhara tora ducaraṇa || 260 ||

janu dui raksha karu — may [He] guard both knees; deva trivikrama — Lord Trivikrama; raksha karu dharadhara — may Dharadhara guard; tora du-charana — Your two feet

260may Lord Trivikrama guard both Your knees,
may Dharadhara guard Your feet."4

সব অঙ্গে ফুৎকৃতি দেই শচীমাতা ।
পুত্রভাবে অতিশয় হৈলা উনমতা ॥ ২৬১ ॥

saba aṅge phutkṛti dei śacīmātā |
putrabhābe atiśaẏa hailā unamatā || 261 ||

saba ange — on all the limbs; phutkriti dei shachimata — mother Shachi blows; putra-bhave — in love for her son; atishaya haila unamata — became utterly beside herself

261Mother Shachi blows upon all His limbs
and, in love for her son, is utterly beside herself.

হেনমতে আনন্দে সানন্দে দিন গেল ।
পরম মঙ্গল কাল আসি সন্ধ্যা হৈল ॥ ২৬২ ॥

henamate ānande sānande dina gela |
parama maṅgala kāla āsi sandhyā haila || 262 ||

hena-mate — thus; anande sanande — in joy and merriment; dina gela — the day passed; parama mangala kala asi — the blessed hour coming; sandhya haila — evening fell

262So in joy and merriment the day passed;
the blessed hour came — evening fell.

সুখে শচী গৌরহরি প্রাঙ্গণে রাখিল ।
দাস-দাসীগণে সন্ধ্যাকার্যে নিয়োজিল ॥ ২৬৩ ॥

sukhe śacī gaurahari prāṅgaṇe rākhila |
dāsa-dāsīgaṇe sandhyākārye niẏojila || 263 ||

sukhe shachi — Shachi happily; gaurahari prangane rakhila — left Gaurahari in the courtyard; dasa-dasigane — the servants and maids; sandhya-karye niyojila — set to the evening tasks

263Happily Shachi left Gaurahari in the courtyard
and sent the servants and maids to do the evening tasks.

হেনমতে দিন-অবসানে সন্ধ্যা হৈল ।
পূর্ণিমার পূর্ণচন্দ্র গগনে উদিল ॥ ২৬৪ ॥

henamate dina-abasāne sandhyā haila |
pūrṇimāra pūrṇacandra gagane udila || 264 ||

hena-mate — thus; dina-avasane — at the end of the day; sandhya haila — evening came; purnimara purnachandra — the full moon of the full-moon day; gagane udila — rose in the sky

264So the day came to an end, evening fell,
and the full moon of the full-moon day rose in the sky.

হেনকালে বিশ্বম্ভর চতুর সুজান ।
মা মা বলিয়া ডাকে যেমত অজ্ঞান ॥ ২৬৫ ॥

henakāle biśbambhara catura sujāna |
mā mā baliẏā ḍāke yemata ajñāna || 265 ||

henakale — at that time; vishvambhara chatura sujana — clever and all-knowing Vishvambhara; ma ma baliya dake — calls "mama, mama"; yemata ajnana — as if ignorant

265Then Vishvambhara, clever and all-knowing,
began to call "Mama, mama!" as if He knew nothing.

শচী বোলে সন্ধ্যাকালে না কর ক্রন্দন ।
যাহা চাহ তাহা দিব শুনহ বচন ॥ ২৬৬ ॥

śacī bole sandhyākāle nā kara krandana |
yāhā cāha tāhā diba śunaha bacana || 266 ||

shachi bole — Shachi says; sandhya-kale — at evening time; na kara krandana — do not cry; yaha chaha taha diba — whatever You want I will give; shunaha vachana — listen to my word

266Shachi says: "Don't cry at evening time;
whatever You want I will give — do as I say."

প্রভু কহে চান্দ দেহ আমারে পাড়িয়া ।
হাসি হাসি শচী বোলে আরে অবোধিয়া ॥ ২৬৭ ॥

prabhu kahe cānda deha āmāre pāṛiẏā |
hāsi hāsi śacī bole āre abodhiẏā || 267 ||

prabhu kahe — the Lord says; chanda deha amare padiya — pluck the moon and give it to Me; hasi hasi shachi bole — laughing, Shachi says; are abodhiya — oh, You silly one

267The Lord says: "Pluck the moon and give it to Me!"
Laughing, Shachi replies: "Oh, You silly child!

ধিক ধিক পুত্র দিলেন মোর ঘরে ।
চান্দ কে বা আকাশের ধরিবারে পারে ॥ ২৬৮ ॥

dhika dhika putra dilena mora ghare |
cānda ke bā ākāśera dharibāre pāre || 268 ||

dhika dhika — fie, fie; putra dilena mora ghare — [such] a son has been given to my house; chanda ke ba akashera — who the moon of the sky; dharibare pare — can catch

268What a son I've been given in my house!
Who can catch the moon in the sky?"

প্রভু বোলে বলিলে যে যাহা চাহ তুমি ।
তাহা দিব এমন কহিলে কেনে বাণী ॥ ২৬৯ ॥

prabhu bole balile ye yāhā cāha tumi |
tāhā diba emana kahile kene bāṇī || 269 ||

prabhu bole — the Lord says; balile ye — you said; yaha chaha tumi taha diba — whatever You want I will give; emana kahile kene vani — why did you say such words

269The Lord says: "You said, 'Whatever You want I will give' —
why then did you say such words?

এই লাগি চান্দ নিতে হৈল মোর মন ।
ইহা বলি উচ্চ করি করয়ে রোদন ॥ ২৭০ ॥

ei lāgi cānda nite haila mora mana |
ihā bali ucca kari karaẏe rodana || 270 ||

ei lagi — for this reason; chanda nite haila mora mana — My mind wanted to take the moon; iha bali — saying this; uchcha kari karaye rodana — weeps loudly

270That is why I wanted to take the moon."
Saying this, He wept loudly.

আঁচলে ধরিয়া কান্দে নানা খটি করে ।
চরণ আছাড়ে করে নয়ান কচালে ॥ ২৭১ ॥

āṁcale dhariẏā kānde nānā khaṭi kare |
caraṇa āchāṛe kare naẏāna kacāle || 271 ||

anchale dhariya — clutching the end of her sari; kande — weeps; nana khati kare — throws tantrums of every kind; charana achhade — stamps His feet; kare nayana kachale — rubs His eyes with His hands

271Clutching the end of her sari, He cries and throws tantrums of every kind,
stamps His feet, rubs His eyes.

মায়ের গলায় ধরি কান্দে গোরা রায় ।
খেলা খেলিবারে আকাশের চান্দ চায় ॥ ২৭২ ॥

māẏera galāẏa dhari kānde gorā rāẏa |
khelā khelibāre ākāśera cānda cāẏa || 272 ||

mayera galaya dhari — clinging to His mother's neck; kande gora raya — Gora Raya weeps; khela khelibare — to play with; akashera chanda chaya — wants the moon of the sky

272Clinging to His mother's neck, Gora Raya weeps:
He wants the moon from the sky to play with.

ক্ষণে খটি ক্ষণে লুটি মায়ের চুলি ছিণ্ডে ।
ধূলায় ধূসর কর হানে নিজ-মুণ্ডে ॥ ২৭৩ ॥

kṣaṇe khaṭi kṣaṇe luṭi māẏera culi chiṇḍe |
dhūlāẏa dhūsara kara hāne nija-muṇḍe || 273 ||

kshane khati — now sulking; kshane luti — now rolling; mayera chuli chhinde — tears His mother's hair; dhulaya dhusara — grey with dust; kara hane nija-munde — strikes His own head with His hand

273Now He sulks, now rolls on the ground, now tears His mother's hair;
all grey with dust, He beats His own head with His hand.

দেখিয়া জননী বোলে অবোধিয়া পুত ।
তোহার চরিত্র মোরে বড় অদ্ভুত ॥ ২৭৪ ॥

dekhiẏā jananī bole abodhiẏā puta |
tohāra caritra more baṛa adbhuta || 274 ||

dekhiya janani bole — seeing, the mother says; abodhiya puta — silly child; tohara charitra — Your doings; more bada adbhuta — are a great marvel to me

274Seeing it, His mother says: "Silly child,
Your doings are a marvel to me!

আকাশের চান্দ কতি পাব ধরিবারে ।
অমন কতেক চান্দ তোমার শরীরে ॥ ২৭৫ ॥

ākāśera cānda kati pāba dharibāre |
amana kateka cānda tomāra śarīre || 275 ||

akashera chanda — the moon of the sky; kati paba dharibare — where can I catch; amana kateka chanda — how many such moons; tomara sharire — on Your body

275Where can I catch the moon in the sky?
How many such moons there are on Your body!

হের দেখ লাজে চান্দ মলিন হইল ।
না বুঝিয়া তোর আগে উদয় করিল ॥ ২৭৬ ॥

hera dekha lāje cānda malina haila |
nā bujhiẏā tora āge udaẏa karila || 276 ||

hera dekha — look; laje chanda malina haila — the moon has grown pale with shame; na bujhiya — without understanding; tora age udaya karila — rose before You

276Look: the moon has grown pale with shame —
without thinking, it rose in front of You.

না জানিঞা নবদ্বীপ-চান্দের উদয় ।
লজ্জা পাঞা মেঘের ভিতরে গিয়া রয় ॥ ২৭৭ ॥

nā jāniñā nabadbīpa-cāndera udaẏa |
lajjā pāñā meghera bhitare giẏā raẏa || 277 ||

na janina — not knowing; navadvipa-chandera udaya — of the rising of the moon of Navadvipa; lajja pana — being ashamed; meghera bhitare giya raya — has gone to stay within the clouds

277Not knowing of the rising of the moon of Navadvipa,
it was ashamed and has gone to hide in the clouds.

নবদ্বীপে হাউ আইল শুনহ বচন ।
না কান্দিহ আরে বাপ আমার জীবন ॥ ২৭৮ ॥

nabadbīpe hāu āila śunaha bacana |
nā kāndiha āre bāpa āmāra jībana || 278 ||

navadvipe hau aila — the bogey has come to Navadvipa; shunaha vachana — listen; na kandiha — do not cry; are bapa — my child; amara jivana — my life

278Listen: the bogey5 has come to Navadvipa!
Don't cry, my child, my life!"

ইহা বলি কোলে করি চুম্ব দেই মুখে ।
আপনা পাসরে দেবী প্রেমানন্দ-সুখে ॥ ২৭৯ ॥

ihā bali kole kari cumba dei mukhe |
āpanā pāsare debī premānanda-sukhe || 279 ||

iha bali — saying this; kole kari — taking Him in her arms; chumba dei mukhe — kisses His face; apana pasare devi — the goddess forgets herself; premananda-sukhe — in the happiness of loving bliss

279Saying this, she takes Him in her arms and kisses His face,
and, happy in the bliss of love, the goddess forgets herself.

আনন্দে সানন্দে শচী সম্পদ-বিহ্বলা ।
দিগ বিদিগ নাহি দেখি পুত্র-লীলা ॥ ২৮০ ॥

ānande sānande śacī sampada-bihbalā |
diga bidiga nāhi dekhi putra-līlā || 280 ||

anande sanande — in joy and merriment; shachi sampada-vihvala — Shachi, overwhelmed by her fortune; diga vidiga nahi — no directions or sub-directions; dekhi putra-lila — seeing her son's play

280In joy and merriment Shachi, overwhelmed by her good fortune,
watching her son's play, cannot tell one direction from another.

অন্তর-উল্লাস শচী গদগদ-ভাষ ।
গোরাগুণ গায় সুখে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ২৮১ ॥

antara-ullāsa śacī gadagada-bhāṣa |
gorāguṇa gāẏa sukhe e locanadāsa || 281 ||

antara-ullasa shachi — Shachi's heart rejoices; gadagada-bhasha — her speech falters; goraguna gaya sukhe — happily sings Gora's virtues; e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa

281Shachi's heart rejoices, her speech falters;
happily this Lochana Dasa sings of Gora's virtues.

Raga dhanashi.6 "Glory, glory, glory to Shachi's son, the youthful source of bliss! With the boys He plays in many ways, performing childish pastimes."

সকল চপল, শিশু সঙ্গে করি,
খেলায় বিবিধ খেলা ।
বালকের সঙ্গে, শিশুক্রীড়া রঙ্গে,
করিয়া কৌতুক-লীলা ॥ ২৮২ ॥

sakala capala, śiśu saṅge kari,
khelāẏa bibidha khelā |
bālakera saṅge, śiśukrīṛā raṅge,
kariẏā kautuka-līlā || 282 ||

sakala chapala shishu — all the lively children; sange kari — taking along; khelaya vividha khela — plays various games; balakera sange — with the boys; shishu-krida range — in childish sport; kariya kautuka-lila — performing playful pastimes

282Taking along all the lively children,
He plays various games;
with the boys, in childish sport,
He performs playful pastimes.

খেলিতে খেলিতে, তথি আচম্বিতে,
শ্বান-শাবক দুই-চারি ।
বাঢ়ল কৌতুক, তহি বাছি এক,
ধরি লইল গৌরহরি ॥ ২৮৩ ॥

khelite khelite, tathi ācambite,
śbāna-śābaka dui-cāri |
bāṛhala kautuka, tahi bāchi eka,
dhari laila gaurahari || 283 ||

khelite khelite — playing; tathi achambite — suddenly there; shvana-shabaka dui-chari — two or four puppies; badhala kautuka — the fun grew; tahi bachhi eka — choosing one there; dhari laila gaurahari — Gaurahari took it

283As they played, suddenly [they saw] there
two or four puppies;
the fun grew: choosing one,
Gaurahari took it.

সঙ্গের ছাওয়ালে, কহিল তাহারে,
শুন শুন বিশ্বম্ভর ।
কুৎসিত ছাড়িলে, ভাল তুমি নিলে,
না খেলিব যাব ঘর ॥ ২৮৪ ॥

saṅgera chāoẏāle, kahila tāhāre,
śuna śuna biśbambhara |
kutsita chāṛile, bhāla tumi nile,
nā kheliba yāba ghara || 284 ||

sangera chhaoyale — the boys with Him; kahila tahare — said to Him; shuna shuna vishvambhara — listen, Vishvambhara; kutsita chhadile — You left the ugly ones; bhala tumi nile — You took the good one; na kheliba — we won't play; yaba ghara — we'll go home

284The boys who were with Him said to Him:
"Listen, listen, Vishvambhara:
You've left us the ugly ones and taken the good one for Yourself —
we won't play, we're going home!"

তবে বিশ্বম্ভর, কহিল উত্তর,
এই শ্বান সভাকার ।
সভে এক হঞা, খেল ইহা লঞা,
থাকিবে ঘরে আমার ॥ ২৮৫ ॥

tabe biśbambhara, kahila uttara,
ei śbāna sabhākāra |
sabhe eka hañā, khela ihā lañā,
thākibe ghare āmāra || 285 ||

tabe vishvambhara — then Vishvambhara; kahila uttara — replied; ei shvana sabhakara — this puppy belongs to all; sabhe eka hana — all together; khela iha lana — play with it; thakibe ghare amara — it will stay at My house

285Then Vishvambhara replied:
"This puppy belongs to everyone;
all of you play with it together,
but it will live at My house."

ইহা বলি সেই, শ্বান-সুত লই,
চলিলা আপন-ঘরে ।
নিজ ঘরে গিয়া, গলে দড়ি দিয়া,
বান্ধিল পিণ্ডার উপরে ॥ ২৮৬ ॥

ihā bali sei, śbāna-suta lai,
calilā āpana-ghare |
nija ghare giẏā, gale daṛi diẏā,
bāndhila piṇḍāra upare || 286 ||

iha bali — saying this; sei shvana-suta lai — taking that puppy; chalila apana-ghare — went to His own house; nija ghare giya — going home; gale dadi diya — putting a rope round its neck; bandhila pindara upare — tied it on the raised step

286Saying this, He took the puppy
and went to His own house;
at home He put a rope round its neck
and tied it on the raised step of the house.

হেনকালে এথা, বিশ্বম্ভর-মাতা,
সমাপিয়া গৃহকাজ ।
স্নান করিবারে, গেলা গঙ্গাতীরে,
পুরনারী করি সাথ ॥ ২৮৭ ॥

henakāle ethā, biśbambhara-mātā,
samāpiẏā gṛhakāja |
snāna karibāre, gelā gaṅgātīre,
puranārī kari sātha || 287 ||

henakale etha — meanwhile; vishvambhara-mata — Vishvambhara's mother; samapiya griha-kaja — finishing the housework; snana karibare — to bathe; gela gangatire — went to the Ganga's bank; puranari kari satha — with the women of the town

287Meanwhile Vishvambhara's mother,
having finished her housework,
went to the bank of the Ganga to bathe
together with the women of the town.

তবে বিশ্বম্ভর, পাঞা শূন্য ঘর,
শ্বানের শাবক লঞা ।
বালকের সঙ্গে, খেলে নানা রঙ্গে,
ধূলায় ধূসর হঞা ॥ ২৮৮ ॥

tabe biśbambhara, pāñā śūnya ghara,
śbānera śābaka lañā |
bālakera saṅge, khele nānā raṅge,
dhūlāẏa dhūsara hañā || 288 ||

tabe vishvambhara — then Vishvambhara; pana shunya ghara — finding the house empty; shvanera shabaka lana — taking the puppy; balakera sange — with the boys; khele nana range — plays in many ways; dhulaya dhusara hana — grey with dust

288Then Vishvambhara, finding the house empty,
took the puppy
and plays with the boys in every way,
grey with dust.

খেলিতে খেলিতে, বালক-সহিতে,
দোঁহে উপজিল দ্বন্দ্ব ।
তবে গৌরহরি, একে পুরস্করি,
আরেরে বলিল মন্দ ॥ ২৮৯ ॥

khelite khelite, bālaka-sahite,
doṁhe upajila dbandba |
tabe gaurahari, eke puraskari,
ārere balila manda || 289 ||

khelite khelite — playing; balaka-sahite — with the boys; donhe upajila dvandva — a quarrel arose between two; tabe gaurahari — then Gaurahari; eke puraskari — favouring one; arere balila manda — spoke ill to the other

289As they played with the boys,
two of them quarrelled;
then Gaurahari, taking one's side,
began to scold the other:

নিতি নিতি আসি, কলহ করসি,
স্বভাব কেমন তোর ।
হেন বুঝি তোর, চরিত্র আচার,
শ্বানের শাবক চোর ॥ ২৯০ ॥

niti niti āsi, kalaha karasi,
sbabhāba kemana tora |
hena bujhi tora, caritra ācāra,
śbānera śābaka cora || 290 ||

niti niti asi — coming every day; kalaha karasi — you start a quarrel; svabhava kemana tora — what is your nature; hena bujhi tora charitra achara — I see your character and conduct; shvanera shabaka chora — a puppy thief

290"Every day you come and start a quarrel —
what sort of nature is that?
I see what you are and how you behave:
you are a puppy thief!"

সেই সেই কালে, রুষিয়া অন্তরে,
বাহিরে চলিল ধাঞা ।
শচীর সম্মুখে, কহে বড় ডাকে,
কোপে গদগদ হঞা ॥ ২৯১ ॥

sei sei kāle, ruṣiẏā antare,
bāhire calila dhāñā |
śacīra sammukhe, kahe baṛa ḍāke,
kope gadagada hañā || 291 ||

sei sei kale — then that [boy]; rushiya antare — angry at heart; bahire chalila dhana — ran outside; shachira sammukhe — before Shachi; kahe bada dake — shouts loudly; kope gadagada hana — choking with rage

291Then that boy, angry at heart,
ran outside
and shouted at the top of his voice before Shachi,
choking with rage:

শুন শুন আরে, তোর বিশ্বম্ভরে,
শ্বানের শাবক লঞা ।
ক্ষণে কোলে করে, ক্ষণে গলে ধরে,
আপনে দেখ না আসিয়া ॥ ২৯২ ॥

śuna śuna āre, tora biśbambhare,
śbānera śābaka lañā |
kṣaṇe kole kare, kṣaṇe gale dhare,
āpane dekha nā āsiẏā || 292 ||

shuna shuna are — listen; tora vishvambhare — your Vishvambhara; shvanera shabaka lana — having taken a puppy; kshane kole kare — now holds it in His arms; kshane gale dhare — now hugs it round the neck; apane dekha na asiya — come and see yourself

292"Listen, your Vishvambhara
has taken a puppy:
now He holds it in His arms, now hugs it round the neck —
come and see for yourself!"

শুনি শচীরাণী, বালকের বাণী,
সত্বরে আইলা ঘরে ।
দেখে পরতেখ, শ্বানের শাবক,
বিশ্বম্ভর কোলে করে ॥ ২৯৩ ॥

śuni śacīrāṇī, bālakera bāṇī,
satbare āilā ghare |
dekhe paratekha, śbānera śābaka,
biśbambhara kole kare || 293 ||

shuni shachirani — hearing, Shachi-rani; balakera vani — the boy's words; satvare aila ghare — hurried home; dekhe paratekha — sees with her own eyes; shvanera shabaka — the puppy; vishvambhara kole kare — Vishvambhara holds in His arms

293Hearing the boy's words,
Shachi-rani hurried home
and sees with her own eyes:
Vishvambhara is holding the puppy in His arms.

শিরে কর হানি, বোলয়ে জননী,
না জানি কি তোর লীলা ।
সকল থাকিতে, অতি বিপরীতে,
কুক্কুর-ছা লঞা খেলা ॥ ২৯৪ ॥

śire kara hāni, bolaẏe jananī,
nā jāni ki tora līlā |
sakala thākite, ati biparīte,
kukkura-chā lañā khelā || 294 ||

shire kara hani — striking her head; bolaye janani — the mother says; na jani ki tora lila — I don't know what Your games are; sakala thakite — though everything is there; ati viparite — most perversely; kukkura-chha lana khela — You play with a puppy

294Striking her head with her hand, the mother says:
"I can't make out Your games!
There are all kinds of games, and You — how perverse! —
are playing with a puppy.

জনক তোহারি, অতি ধর্মচারী,
তাহার তনয় তুমি ।
কি বলিবে লোকে, শ্বানের শাবকে,
খেলাহ কি সুখ মানি ॥ ২৯৫ ॥

janaka tohāri, ati dharmacārī,
tāhāra tanaẏa tumi |
ki balibe loke, śbānera śābake,
khelāha ki sukha māni || 295 ||

janaka tohari — Your father; ati dharmachari — is most pious; tahara tanaya tumi — You are his son; ki balibe loke — what will people say; shvanera shabake khelaha — You play with a puppy; ki sukha mani — finding what pleasure

295Your father is a most pious man,
and You are his son:
what will people say? With a puppy
You play — what pleasure do You find in it?

ব্রাহ্মণকুমার, হেনই আচার,
কিছুই নহিল তোর ।
ইহা যে শুনিব, কে ভাল বলিব,
এ শেল হৃদয়ে মোর ॥ ২৯৬ ॥

brāhmaṇakumāra, henai ācāra,
kichui nahila tora |
ihā ye śuniba, ke bhāla baliba,
e śela hṛdaẏe mora || 296 ||

brahmana-kumara — a brahmana's son; henai achara kichhui nahila tora — there is nothing of such conduct in You; iha ye shuniba — whoever hears this; ke bhala baliba — who will speak well; e shela hridaye mora — this is a spear in my heart

296You are a brahmana's son —
yet there is nothing of such conduct in You;
whoever hears of this — who will speak well of it?
It is a spear in my heart.

এহেন সুন্দর, মূরতি তোহার,
ধূলা মাখ কিবা সুখে ।
বলিতে বচন, নামাহ বদন,
আগি লাগু মোর মুখে ॥ ২৯৭ ॥

ehena sundara, mūrati tohāra,
dhūlā mākha kibā sukhe |
balite bacana, nāmāha badana,
āgi lāgu mora mukhe || 297 ||

ehena sundara murati tohara — Your form is so beautiful; dhula makha kiba sukhe — what joy in smearing dust; balite vachana — when I speak; namaha badana — You lower Your face; agi lagu mora mukhe — may fire seize my mouth

297You are so beautiful —
what joy is there in smearing Yourself with dust?
I speak to You, and You lower Your eyes —
may my mouth be burned!

কত চান্দ জিনি, তোর মুখখানি,
এ থির-বিজুরি অঙ্গ ।
বেশ নাহি চায়, ধূলা মাখ গায়,
অধম-বালক-সঙ্গ ॥ ২৯৮ ॥

kata cānda jini, tora mukhakhāni,
e thira-bijuri aṅga |
beśa nāhi cāẏa, dhūlā mākha gāẏa,
adhama-bālaka-saṅga || 298 ||

kata chanda jini — surpassing many moons; tora mukhakhani — Your face; e thira-bijuri anga — the body steady lightning; besha nahi chaya — You care not for fine dress; dhula makha gaya — You smear dust on Your body; adhama-balaka-sanga — company of bad boys

298Your face surpasses many moons,
Your body is steady lightning;
yet You care nothing for fine clothes, You smear dust on Your body,
You keep company with bad boys."

ক্রোধে শচীদেবী, দন্তে ওষ্ঠ চাপি,
বালকেরে দেই গালি ।
নিজঘরে যাহ, কুক্কুর-ছা লহ,
মা-বাপেরে দেহ ডালি ॥ ২৯৯ ॥

krodhe śacīdebī, dante oṣṭha cāpi,
bālakere dei gāli |
nijaghare yāha, kukkura-chā laha,
mā-bāpere deha ḍāli || 299 ||

krodhe shachidevi — in anger Shachi-devi; dante oshtha chapi — biting her lip; balakere dei gali — scolds the boy; nija-ghare yaha — go home; kukkura-chha laha — take the puppy; ma-bapere deha dali — give it as a present to your mother and father

299In anger Shachi-devi, biting her lip,
scolds the boy:
"Go home, take the puppy,
make a present of it to your father and mother!"

ইহা বলি সেই, পুত্র-মুখ চাই,
ডাকয়ে আনন্দে ভোর ।
আইস আইস বাপ, কোলে আসি চাপ,
বদন চুম্বউ তোর ॥ ৩০০ ॥

ihā bali sei, putra-mukha cāi,
ḍākaẏe ānande bhora |
āisa āisa bāpa, kole āsi cāpa,
badana cumbau tora || 300 ||

iha bali — saying this; sei putra-mukha chai — she, looking at her son's face; dakaye anande bhora — calls, overwhelmed with joy; aisa aisa bapa — come, come, child; kole asi chapa — climb into my arms; badana chumbau tora — let me kiss Your face

300Saying this, she looks at her son's face
and calls Him, beside herself with joy:
"Come, come, child, climb into my arms,
let me kiss Your face!

শ্বানের শাবক, এড়ি দেহ বাপ,
স্নান কর গঙ্গাজলে ।
বেলি দুই-পহর, ক্ষুধা নাহি তোর,
কত দুখ দেহ মোরে ॥ ৩০১ ॥

śbānera śābaka, eṛi deha bāpa,
snāna kara gaṅgājale |
beli dui-pahara, kṣudhā nāhi tora,
kata dukha deha more || 301 ||

shvanera shabaka — the puppy; edi deha bapa — let go, child; snana kara gangajale — bathe in the Ganga's water; beli dui-pahara — it is midday; kshudha nahi tora — You are not hungry; kata dukha deha more — how much grief You give me

301Let the puppy go, child,
and bathe in the Ganga's water;
it is already midday — aren't You hungry?
How much grief You cause me!

নহে শ্বান-সুত, বান্ধি রাখ পুত,
স্নান করিবারে যাহ ।
বিকালে খেলিহ, কুক্কুর-ছা লহ,
এখনে ত কিছু খাহ ॥ ৩০২ ॥

nahe śbāna-suta, bāndhi rākha puta,
snāna karibāre yāha |
bikāle kheliha, kukkura-chā laha,
ekhane ta kichu khāha || 302 ||

nahe — otherwise; shvana-suta bandhi rakha puta — tie up the puppy, child; snana karibare yaha — go to bathe; vikale kheliha — play in the afternoon; kukkura-chha laha — take the puppy; ekhane ta kichhu khaha — but now eat something

302Or else tie up the puppy, child,
and go to bathe;
in the afternoon You can play and take the puppy,
but now eat something.

ও মুখ মলিন, সোণার নলিন,
আতপে যেন মলান ।
নাসিকার আগে, ঘর্মবিন্দু জাগে,
দেখিতে বিদরে প্রাণ ॥ ৩০৩ ॥

o mukha malina, soṇāra nalina,
ātape yena malāna |
nāsikāra āge, gharmabindu jāge,
dekhite bidare prāṇa || 303 ||

o mukha malina — that face has grown pale; sonara nalina — a golden lotus; atape yena malana — as if withered in the sun; nasikara age — at the tip of the nose; gharma-bindu jage — drops of sweat appear; dekhite vidare prana — seeing it the heart breaks

303Your face, a golden lotus, has grown pale,
as if withered in the sun;
drops of sweat stand on the tip of Your nose —
it breaks my heart to see!"

মায়ের উত্তর, শুনি বিশ্বম্ভর,
হাসি উঠি বলে বাণী ।
মোর শ্বান-ছা, জানি যায় কোথা,
তবে সে জানিবে আপনি ॥ ৩০৪ ॥

māẏera uttara, śuni biśbambhara,
hāsi uṭhi bale bāṇī |
mora śbāna-chā, jāni yāẏa kothā,
tabe se jānibe āpani || 304 ||

mayera uttara — His mother's answer; shuni vishvambhara — hearing, Vishvambhara; hasi uthi bale vani — laughing, stands and says; mora shvana-chha — My puppy; jani yaya kotha — if it goes anywhere; tabe se janibe apani — then you yourself will find out

304Hearing His mother's answer, Vishvambhara
laughed, stood up and says:
"If My puppy goes anywhere,
then you yourself will find out!"

ইহা বলি হরি, মায়ের গলা ধরি,
স্নান করিবারে যায় ।
এ ধূলি ঝাড়িয়া, বদন মুছিয়া,
গন্ধ-তৈল দিল গায় ॥ ৩০৫ ॥

ihā bali hari, māẏera galā dhari,
snāna karibāre yāẏa |
e dhūli jhāṛiẏā, badana muchiẏā,
gandha-taila dila gāẏa || 305 ||

iha bali hari — saying this, Hari; mayera gala dhari — hugging His mother's neck; snana karibare yaya — goes to bathe; e dhuli jhadiya — brushing off the dust; badana muchhiya — wiping the face; gandha-taila dila gaya — rubbed fragrant oil on His body

305Saying this, Hari hugged His mother's neck
and goes to bathe;
she brushed off His dust, wiped His face
and rubbed His body with fragrant oil.

স্নান করিবারে, যায় গঙ্গাতীরে,
বয়স্য করিয়া সঙ্গে ।
সুরনদী-জলে, অতি কুতূহলে,
জলক্রীড়া করে রঙ্গে ॥ ৩০৬ ॥

snāna karibāre, yāẏa gaṅgātīre,
baẏasya kariẏā saṅge |
suranadī-jale, ati kutūhale,
jalakrīṛā kare raṅge || 306 ||

snana karibare — to bathe; yaya gangatire — goes to the Ganga's bank; vayasya kariya sange — taking His companions along; suranadi-jale — in the water of the heavenly river; ati kutuhale — in great merriment; jala-krida kare range — sports joyfully in the water

306To bathe He goes to the bank of the Ganga,
taking His companions along,
and in the water of the heavenly river, in great merriment,
He frolics and splashes.

সভে সভা-অঙ্গে, জল দেই রঙ্গে,
মাতিল কুঞ্জর যেন ।
গোরার এ তনু, সুমেরু সে জনু,
অটল অদ্ভুত হেন ॥ ৩০৭ ॥

sabhe sabhā-aṅge, jala dei raṅge,
mātila kuñjara yena |
gorāra e tanu, sumeru se janu,
aṭala adbhuta hena || 307 ||

sabhe sabha-ange — all on each other's bodies; jala dei range — splash water merrily; matila kunjara yena — like frolicking elephants; gorara e tanu — and Gora's body; sumeru se janu — like Mount Sumeru; atala adbhuta hena — unshakeable and wondrous

307They all splash one another with water
like frolicking elephants;
and Gora's body is like Mount Sumeru —
unshakeable, wondrous.

এথা শচীদেবী, মনে অনুভবি,
শ্বানের ছা এড়ি দিল ।
নিজমাতা পাঞা, সঙ্গে গেল ধাঞা,
না জানি কোথারে গেল ॥ ৩০৮ ॥

ethā śacīdebī, mane anubhabi,
śbānera chā eṛi dila |
nijamātā pāñā, saṅge gela dhāñā,
nā jāni kothāre gela || 308 ||

etha shachidevi — meanwhile Shachi-devi; mane anubhavi — after thinking; shvanera chha edi dila — let the puppy go; nija-mata pana — finding its own mother; sange gela dhana — ran along with her; na jani kothare gela — who knows where it went

308Meanwhile Shachi-devi, after some thought,
let the puppy go;
seeing its own mother, it ran after her —
who knows where it went.

সেইখানে এক, আছিল বালক,
ধাঞা গেল গঙ্গাকূলে ।
শুন বিশ্বম্ভর, জননী তোমার,
শ্বান-সুত এড়ি দিলে ॥ ৩০৯ ॥

seikhāne eka, āchila bālaka,
dhāñā gela gaṅgākūle |
śuna biśbambhara, jananī tomāra,
śbāna-suta eṛi dile || 309 ||

seikhane eka achhila balaka — there was a boy there; dhana gela gangakule — ran to the Ganga's bank; shuna vishvambhara — listen, Vishvambhara; janani tomara — your mother; shvana-suta edi dile — has let the puppy go

309There was a boy there —
he ran to the bank of the Ganga:
"Listen, Vishvambhara: your mother
has let the puppy go!"

বালক-বচন, শুনিঞা তখন,
সত্বরে আইলা ধাঞা ।
যেখানে থাকিত, সেই শ্বান-সুত,
সেখানে দেখিল গিয়া ॥ ৩১০ ॥

bālaka-bacana, śuniñā takhana,
satbare āilā dhāñā |
yekhāne thākita, sei śbāna-suta,
sekhāne dekhila giẏā || 310 ||

balaka-vachana shunina takhana — hearing then the boy's words; satvare aila dhana — came running at once; yekhane thakita sei shvana-suta — where that puppy used to be; sekhane dekhila giya — there He went and looked

310Hearing the boy's words,
He came running at once
and went to look in the place
where the puppy had been.

চারিপানে চাহি, শ্বান-শিশু নাহি,
অন্তর জ্বলিল কোপে ।
কান্দে উভরায়, গালি দেই মায়,
শ্বানের শাবক-শোকে ॥ ৩১১ ॥

cāripāne cāhi, śbāna-śiśu nāhi,
antara jbalila kope |
kānde ubharāẏa, gāli dei māẏa,
śbānera śābaka-śoke || 311 ||

charipane chahi — looking all around; shvana-shishu nahi — no puppy; antara jvalila kope — His heart blazed with anger; kande ubharaya — weeps aloud; gali dei maya — scolds His mother; shvanera shabaka-shoke — in grief for the puppy

311He looks in all four directions — no puppy;
His heart blazed with anger.
He weeps loudly and scolds His mother,
grieving for the puppy:

শুন অবোধিনি, কি কৈলি জননি,
এ দুঃখ দেয়লি মোরে ।
পরম সুন্দর, শ্বান-শিশুবর,
কেমনে দিলি কাহারে ॥ ৩১২ ॥

śuna abodhini, ki kaili janani,
e duḥkha deẏali more |
parama sundara, śbāna-śiśubara,
kemane dili kāhāre || 312 ||

shuna abodhini — listen, foolish one; ki kaili janani — what have you done, mother; e duhkha deyali more — you have given Me this grief; parama sundara shvana-shishuvara — the most beautiful, best of puppies; kemane dili kahare — how could you give to someone

312"Listen, foolish one, what have you done, mother?
What grief you have caused Me!
The most beautiful, the best of puppies —
how could you give it to someone?"

বোলে শচীরাণী, আমি ত না জানি,
শ্বানের শাবক তোর ।
এইখানে ছিল, কেবা কতি নিল,
কেমন বালক চোর ॥ ৩১৩ ॥

bole śacīrāṇī, āmi ta nā jāni,
śbānera śābaka tora |
eikhāne chila, kebā kati nila,
kemana bālaka cora || 313 ||

bole shachirani — Shachi-rani says; ami ta na jani — I don't know; shvanera shabaka tora — [where] your puppy [is]; eikhane chhila — it was here; keba kati nila — someone took it somewhere; kemana balaka chora — what a thieving boy

313Shachi-rani says: "But I don't know
[where] your puppy is;
it was here — someone took it somewhere;
what a thieving boy!

কোন প্রয়োজনে, করহ ক্রন্দনে,
কুক্কুর-শাবক লাগি ।
লইল যে জন, করিয়া যতন,
কালি আনি দিব মাগি ॥ ৩১৪ ॥

kona praẏojane, karaha krandane,
kukkura-śābaka lāgi |
laila ye jana, kariẏā yatana,
kāli āni diba māgi || 314 ||

kona prayojane — for what reason; karaha krandane — do You weep; kukkura-shabaka lagi — over a puppy; laila ye jana — whoever took it; kariya yatana — taking pains; kali ani diba magi — tomorrow I'll ask for it and bring it

314Why do You cry
over a puppy?
Whoever took it, I'll take the trouble
to ask for it and bring it tomorrow.

করহ অবধি, আপন শপথি,
করিয়া বোলোঁ মো তোরে ।
শ্বানের শাবকে, আনি দিব তোকে,
না কান্দ না কান্দ আরে ॥ ৩১৫ ॥

karaha abadhi, āpana śapathi,
kariẏā boloṁ mo tore |
śbānera śābake, āni diba toke,
nā kānda nā kānda āre || 315 ||

karaha avadhi — enough now; apana shapathi kariya — swearing my own oath; bolon mo tore — I tell You; shvanera shabake ani diba toke — I will bring the puppy to You; na kanda na kanda are — don't cry, don't cry now

315Enough now! I swear to You
by my own oath:
I will bring the puppy to You —
don't cry, don't cry now!"

এতেক বলিয়া, বয়ান মুছিয়া,
পুত্র কোলে করি নিল ।
শ্রীমুখ চাহিয়া, হরষিত হঞা,
লাখ লাখ চুম্ব দিল ॥ ৩১৬ ॥

eteka baliẏā, baẏāna muchiẏā,
putra kole kari nila |
śrīmukha cāhiẏā, haraṣita hañā,
lākha lākha cumba dila || 316 ||

eteka baliya — saying this; bayana muchhiya — wiping His face; putra kole kari nila — took her son in her arms; shrimukha chahiya — gazing at the beautiful face; harashita hana — joyfully; lakha lakha chumba dila — gave countless kisses

316Saying this, she wiped His face
and took her son in her arms;
gazing at His beautiful face, joyfully
she covered Him with countless kisses.

অঙ্গের মার্জনা, করি শুচিপনা,
স্নান কৈলা গঙ্গাজলে ।
সন্দেশ মোদক, ক্ষীর কদলক,
ভক্ষণ করাইল ভালে ॥ ৩১৭ ॥

aṅgera mārjanā, kari śucipanā,
snāna kailā gaṅgājale |
sandeśa modaka, kṣīra kadalaka,
bhakṣaṇa karāila bhāle || 317 ||

angera marjana — rubbing the body; kari shuchipana — making Him clean; snana kaila gangajale — bathed Him in the Ganga's water; sandesha modaka — sandesh and modakas; kshira kadalaka — thickened milk and bananas; bhakshana karaila bhale — fed Him well

317Rubbing His body and making Him clean,
she bathed Him in the Ganga's water
and fed Him well with sweets — sandesh and modakas,
thickened milk and bananas.

তিন ঝুটি মাথে, পাঁচ থুপী তাথে,
একত্র করিয়া বান্ধি ।
নয়নে কাজর, সুরেখা উজর,
দিঠি এ জগত রঞ্জি ॥ ৩১৮ ॥

tina jhuṭi māthe, pāṁca thupī tāthe,
ekatra kariẏā bāndhi |
naẏane kājara, surekhā ujara,
diṭhi e jagata rañji || 318 ||

tina jhuti mathe — three tufts on the head; pancha thupi tathe — five knots on them; ekatra kariya bandhi — tied together; nayane kajara — kajal in the eyes; surekha ujara — a fine, bright line; dithi e jagata ranji — the glance delights the world

318On His head are three tufts, with five knots on them,
tied together;
in His eyes is kajal, a clear, fine line;
His glance delights the world.

রক্ত-প্রান্ত ধড়া, কটি দিয়া বেড়া,
প্রপদ-অঞ্চল দোলে ।
মুকুতার হার, হিয়ার উপর,
চন্দন-তিলক ভালে ॥ ৩১৯ ॥

rakta-prānta dhaṛā, kaṭi diẏā beṛā,
prapada-añcala dole |
mukutāra hāra, hiẏāra upara,
candana-tilaka bhāle || 319 ||

rakta-pranta dhada — a red-bordered dhoti; kati diya beda — wrapped round the waist; prapada-anchala dole — its end swings to the feet; mukutara hara — a pearl necklace; hiyara upara — on the breast; chandana-tilaka bhale — sandal tilaka on the forehead

319A red-bordered dhoti is wrapped round His waist,
its end swinging down to His feet;
on His breast a pearl necklace,
on His forehead a sandal tilaka.

অঙ্গদ কঙ্কণ, অমূল্য রতন,
চরণে মগরা খাড়ু ।
বালকের ঠাঁই, খেলিবারে যাই,
হাতে করি ক্ষীর-লাড়ু ॥ ৩২০ ॥

aṅgada kaṅkaṇa, amūlya ratana,
caraṇe magarā khāṛu |
bālakera ṭhāṁi, khelibāre yāi,
hāte kari kṣīra-lāṛu || 320 ||

angada kankana — armlets and bracelets; amulya ratana — priceless jewels; charane magara khadu — magara anklets on the feet; balakera thani — to the boys; khelibare yai — goes to play; hate kari kshira-ladu — holding a milk laddu in hand

320Armlets and bracelets, priceless jewels,
magara anklets on His feet;
He goes to the boys to play,
holding a milk laddu in His hand.

গমন সুন্দর, জিনিঞা কুঞ্জর,
বচন গভীর মধু ।
বালকের মাঝে, গোরা দ্বিজরাজে,
তারায়ে বেঢ়ল বিধু ॥ ৩২১ ॥

gamana sundara, jiniñā kuñjara,
bacana gabhīra madhu |
bālakera mājhe, gorā dbijarāje,
tārāẏe beṛhala bidhu || 321 ||

gamana sundara — the gait beautiful; jinina kunjara — surpassing an elephant; vachana gabhira madhu — speech deep and sweet; balakera majhe — among the boys; gora dvijaraje — Gora, king of the twice-born; taraye bedhala vidhu — the moon surrounded by stars

321His gait is beautiful, surpassing an elephant's,
His speech deep and sweet;
Gora, king of the twice-born, among the boys —
the moon surrounded by stars.7

ঐছন লীলায়, ঠাকুর খেলায়,
দেবতা দেখিয়া ভাসে ।
মার্জার কুক্কুর, পরশে ঠাকুর,
কৌতুক লোচনদাসে ॥ ৩২২ ॥

aichana līlāẏa, ṭhākura khelāẏa,
debatā dekhiẏā bhāse |
mārjāra kukkura, paraśe ṭhākura,
kautuka locanadāse || 322 ||

aichhana lilaya — in such pastimes; thakura khelaya — the Lord plays; devata dekhiya bhase — the gods watch and are swept away; marjara kukkura — cats and dogs; parashe thakura — the Lord touches; kautuka lochanadase — Lochana Dasa marvels

322In such pastimes the Lord plays —
the gods watch and are swept away in bliss;
cats and dogs the Lord touches —
Lochana Dasa marvels.

✦

Notes

  1. So in Bhaktisiddhanta's edition (kapata murchchha — "a feigned, seeming swoon"); the 1983 and 1903 editions have simply "she fainted". In Murari Gupta (1.06.22) Shachi loses consciousness from the blow. The word "seeming" indicates that this is no worldly misfortune but play: the Lord's mother is His eternal associate, and her swoon is part of the lila.
  2. The words "untainted, pure, without form" (nirlepa, niranjana, nirakara) are taken from the language of the Upanishads. The Gaudiya Vaishnavas, following the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 6, the conversation with Sarvabhauma), understand such epithets as denying only material qualities and a material form: the Lord has an eternal form full of being, knowledge and bliss — the very form Shachi sees before her (vv. 245–246).
  3. Cf. the Bhagavata (10.8.43): having seen the universe in Krishna's mouth, Yashoda by the Lord's will again forgot His majesty and saw in Him only her son. This is the working of yogamaya, which nourishes vatsalya-rasa, not worldly ignorance.
  4. A protective prayer assigning names of Vishnu to each limb — as the gopis protected the infant Krishna after the Putana episode (Bhagavata 10.6.21–29). Giridhara — "the lifter of the hill" (Krishna); Trivikrama — Vamana; Dharadhara — "the upholder of the earth" (Varaha or Shesha).
  5. Hau — a bogey used to frighten children (cf. en/10, v. 121).
  6. In A an unclear word follows (perhaps an indication of metre).
  7. "King of the twice-born" (dvijaraja) — both the best of brahmanas and the moon.
